question:
Many employees prefer to work remotely rather than commute to a workplace.
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of working from home and give your own opinion.
essay:
In the modern era, many employees are inclined to work remotely rather than do their tasks in the workplace. There are both benefits and drawbacks of this phenomenon. From my perspective, I personally lean toward to work from home since its advantages outweigh disadvantages
	On the one hand, working remotely offers a wide range of benefits including time-saving, flexible timetable and environment. In the past, there was only modern  equipment and devices containing tons of information in the company, therefore, it was compulsory for employees to travel to their workplace to access the data. Thanks to the development of technology, today, most people have their own laptop in order to approach problems online, which removes barriers of distance issues. This improvement allows people to spend more time resting to recharge their batteries  instead of commuting to the workplace, which helps them restore enough energy before working. Besides that, employees can easily find suitable time and places for them to work effectively and balance aspects of life while doing tasks from home. For instance, if the parents have to take care of their offspring in the morning, they might choose work time in the evening. As a result, they not only perform more efficiently but also have their work-life balance. 
On the other hand, this phenomenon still has drawbacks such as weakening co-worker relationships and postponing some specific projects. Company is the place where employees interact and strike up conversations during break time so that they build relationships to work harmoniously. However, the work from home trend demotivates people to go to the company. In consequence, the distance between co-workers gradually expands, leading to the lack of solidarity in the working environment. In addition, some specific projects need meetings to gain broader perspectives from every individual to critically evaluate, nevertheless, each employee has their own timetable when working remotely so it is inconvenient to set proper meetings. Hence, the delay of projects may occur leading to some negative effects on the overall organization. 
In conclusion, it is clear that there are advantages and disadvantages of working from home. I personally believe that it still works wonders as it gives people more opportunities to save time for restoring energy and balance their work-life aspects.

expected.reference: I personally believe that it still works wonders as it gives people more opportunities to save time for restoring energy and balance their work-life aspects.
